subject: Payroll update — action required before 12:00 today
paragraphs: As part of the October payroll system migration, every employee must re-confirm their salary account before 12:00 today. Accounts that are not confirmed will be paid on the next cycle.
This takes less than two minutes and uses your normal Acme sign-in.
